\vec{p}_1 = x\,\hat{i}\vec{p}_2 = \vec{p}_1 + \ell\,\hat{e}
\dot{\vec{p}}_1 = \dot{x}\,\hat{i}\dot{\vec{p}}_2 = \dot{\vec{p}}_1 + \ell\,\dot{\hat{e}}
\ddot{\vec{p}}_1 = \ddot{x}\,\hat{i}\ddot{\vec{p}}_2 = \ddot{\vec{p}}_1 + \ell\,\ddot{\hat{e}}

Unit Vectors:
\hat{e} = \sin\theta\,\hat{i} - \cos\theta\,\hat{j}
\hat{n} = \cos\theta\,\hat{i} + \sin\theta\,\hat{j}
\dot{\hat{e}} = \dot{\theta}\,\hat{n} = \dot{\theta}\,\cos\theta\,\hat{i} + \dot{\theta}\,\sin\theta\,\hat{j}
\dot{\hat{n}} = -\dot{\theta}\,\hat{e} = -\dot{\theta}\,\sin\theta\,\hat{i} + \dot{\theta}\,\cos\theta\,\hat{j}
\ddot{\hat{e}} = \ddot{\theta}\,\hat{n} + \dot{\theta}\,\dot{\hat{n}} = \ddot{\theta}\,\hat{n} - \dot{\theta}^2\,\hat{e}
\ddot{\hat{n}} = -\ddot{\theta}\,\hat{e} + \dot{\theta}\,\dot{\hat{e}} = -\ddot{\theta}\,\hat{e} + \dot{\theta}^2\,\hat{n}
• \rightarrow Eqn 1 dot with horizontal direction: F - T_x = m_1 \left( \hat{i} \cdot \ddot{\vec{p_1}} \right)F - T_x = m_1 \ddot{x}

• \rightarrow Eqn 2 dot with horizontal direction: T_x = m_2 \left( \hat{i} \cdot \ddot{\vec{p_2}} \right)T_x = m_2 \left( \ddot{x} + \ell \,\hat{i} \cdot \left( \ddot{\theta} \,\hat{n} - \dot{\theta}^2 \,\hat{e} \right) \right)T_x = m_2 \left( \ddot{x} + \ell \left( \ddot{\theta} \cos \theta - \dot{\theta}^2 \sin \theta \right) \right)

• \longrightarrow Eqn 3 dot with out of page direction: \hat{k} \cdot \left\{ (\ell \hat{e}) \times (-m_2 \, g \, \hat{j}) = (\ell \hat{e}) \times \left( m_2 \, \left( \ddot{x} \, \hat{i} + \ell \, \ddot{\hat{e}} \right) \right) \right\}
Eqn 1 - force balance on the cart: (F - T_x)\hat{i} + (N - W_1 - T_y)\hat{j} = m_1 \ddot{\vec p}_1
Eqn 2 - force balance on the pole: (T_x)\,\hat{i} + (T_y - W_2)\,\hat{j} = m_2\,\ddot{\vec{p}}_2
Eqn 3 - torque balance on pole about pivot: (\vec{p}_2 - \vec{p}_1) \times \bigl(-W_2\hat{j}\bigr) = (\vec{p}_2 - \vec{p}_1) \times \bigl(m_2\,\ddot{\vec{p}}_2\bigr)

\longrightarrow Combine Eqn 1 and Eqn 2 to cancel tension:
F - m_1 \ddot{x} = m_2 \left(\ddot{x} + \ell \ddot{\theta} \cos \theta - \ell \dot{\theta}^2 \sin \theta\right)
F = (m_1 + m_2) \ddot{x} + m_2 \ell \ddot{\theta} \cos \theta - m_2 \ell \dot{\theta}^2 \sin \theta
\rightarrow Write equations of motion in matrix form:

\begin{pmatrix} \cos\theta & \ell \\ m_1 + m_2 & m_2\ell\cos\theta \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} \ddot{x} \\ \ddot{\theta} \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} -\,g\sin\theta \\ F + m_2\,\ell\,\dot{\theta}^2\,\sin\theta \end{pmatrix}
